incident_description.description: Claimant's own words describing the incident, verbatim where possible

incident_date.description: ISO 8601 date string or null if not provided

estimated_damage.description: Dollar value or null if claimant declined or was unclear

policy_number_confirmed.description: Policy number as spoken by claimant, or null if not provided

policy_active.description: True if claimant confirmed policy is active. Null if not established.

coverage_verified.description: Whether the relevant coverage type was confirmed. Never guess — use unknown.

prior_claims_12mo.description: True if claimant confirmed prior claims in 12 months. Null if not asked or declined.

adjuster_notified.description: True if CALL-E informed claimant an adjuster will follow up.

claimant_questions.description: Verbatim any questions the claimant asked that CALL-E could not answer.
